messages.content: I think I might be more introverted than I thought.
Interesting - what made you notice that recently?
I used to love big group hangouts, now they just drain me completely.
That's a pretty real shift, honestly, and it happens more than people admit - preferences change with age or just with what's going on in your life. Has anything else changed around the same time?
Work's been way more social lately, maybe I'm just tapped out from that.

That actually makes a lot of sense - it might not be a core personality shift at all, just social battery depletion from work bleeding into your free time. Worth testing before you relabel your whole personality over it.
